title: This 30-Year-Old Terminator VFX BLEW OUR MINDS!
summary: Corridor Crew dive into the visual effects of Terminator 2 and try recreating the T-1000 bars scene with modern tools. They explain how the original effects were achieved.
why: Recommended in threads about practical versus CGI effects as a fun, instructive attempt to match a classic effect on a small budget.

quote.text: Highly recommend to watch their video.
